title: Eventual descent morphism for a fixed local map family
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder, $R:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a functor with Noetherian rings $R_k$, and $c$ a limit cone of $R^{\mathrm{op}}\circ\operatorname{Spec}$ with affine vertex $S$. Fix $i\in I$ and a quasi-compact, quasi-separated, locally finitely presented morphism $f:X_i\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)$ [def-pc-scheme]. Put $X=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)} S$, and $X_j=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)}\operatorname{Spec}(R_j)$ for $j\geq i$ [def-pc-base-change]. Fix $j\geq i$, finitely presented quasi-coherent modules $F_j,G_j$ on $X_j$ [pqf-def-coherent], and a stage $k\geq j$. Write X_t for the base change of X_i to Spec R_t. At stage k let A_0 be tensor pullback from X_j to X_k and B_0 tensor pullback from X_k to X. Let δ:B_0(A_0(F_j))→B_0(A_0(G_j)) be any global map. Let U_0 be a finite affine open cover of X_k and r_0 a family of maps between the restrictions of A_0(F_j) and A_0(G_j), whose limit pullbacks recover the restrictions of δ through the canonical restriction comparison [def-pc-open-cover-tensor-pullback-comparison]. There exists l≥k such that, writing q:X_l→X_k, U=q^*U_0, C=q^* for tensor pullback and Q for the ordinary restriction-to-descent-data functor, each member of U is affine. Moreover, for every two modules F',G' on X_l and global maps κ:F'→C(A_0(F_j)), ρ:C(A_0(G_j))→G', the family obtained by restricting κ, then applying the canonical restriction comparison to q^*r_0, and then restricting ρ is the component family of a descent morphism Q(F')→Q(G'). Its components equal this explicit family. No recovery assertion at stage l is made.

proof.text: Substitute the prescribed module base-change functor. Transfer finite presentation and quasi-coherence of its two images through the tensor/native pullback natural isomorphism.

For each ordered pair of affine cover members apply finitePresentation_local_map_pair_eventually to the two stage-k modules, the recovered global map, and the prescribed local family. Each equation holds at every stage above its supplied bound.

Take an upper bound of k and the image of the finite set of ordered pairs under the supplied stage function. At this stage every universal-test pair equation holds. Construct the descent morphism with components the identity-composed canonical pullbacks of r₀. The cover members are affine because the transition is an affine base change.

For arbitrary F′, G′, κ and ρ compose that descent morphism with Q.map κ on the left and Q.map ρ on the right. The component formula for composition and the restriction functor, followed by functoriality of identities and associativity, is exactly localMapPullbackFamily.

lean.statement:
theorem finitePresentation_local_maps_eventual_overlap_equations
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
    (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt]
    (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] :
    (∀ (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j) (Fj Gj : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).Modules),
      Fj.IsFinitePresentation → Fj.IsQuasicoherent →
      Gj.IsFinitePresentation → Gj.IsQuasicoherent →
      ∀ (k : I) (hjk : j ≤ k),
        ∀ (A₀ : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).Modules ⥤
            (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk))))).Modules),
          A₀ = Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
            (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
            (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
            (Over.homMk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hjk)))
              (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← R.map_comp]; rfl)) →
        let B₀ := Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
              (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
              (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
              (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op k)) (c.w (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)).op))
        ∀ δ : B₀.obj (A₀.obj Fj) ⟶ B₀.obj (A₀.obj Gj),
        ∀ (U₀ : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk))))).OpenCover.{u}),
          Finite U₀.I₀ → (∀ a, IsAffine (U₀.X a)) →
          let Q₀ := modulesPseudofunctor.toDescentData U₀.f
          let p₀ := baseChangeMap f
            (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
            (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
            (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op k)) (c.w (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)).op))
          let V₀ := U₀.pullback₁ p₀
          ∀ r₀ : ∀ a, (Q₀.obj (A₀.obj Fj)).obj a ⟶ (Q₀.obj (A₀.obj Gj)).obj a,
            localMapRecovery p₀ U₀ (A₀.obj Fj) (A₀.obj Gj) δ r₀ →
          ∃ (j' : I) (hkj' : k ≤ j'),
            let q := (baseChangeMap f
              (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
              (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans (hjk.trans hkj'))))))
              (Over.homMk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hkj')))
                (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← R.map_comp]; rfl)));
            let U : (pullback f
              (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans (hjk.trans hkj')))))).OpenCover.{u} :=
              U₀.pullback₁ q
            let Q := modulesPseudofunctor.toDescentData U.f
            let C := Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q
            (∀ α, IsAffine (U.X α)) ∧
            (∀ (F' G' : (pullback f
                (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans (hjk.trans hkj')))))).Modules)
              (κ : F' ⟶ C.obj (A₀.obj Fj)) (ρ : C.obj (A₀.obj Gj) ⟶ G'),
              let r : ∀ α, (Q.obj F').obj α ⟶ (Q.obj G').obj α :=
                localMapPullbackFamily q U₀ (A₀.obj Fj) (A₀.obj Gj) F' G' κ ρ r₀
              ∃ ψ : Q.obj F' ⟶ Q.obj G', ∀ α, ψ.hom α = r α))
